title: IMPLICIT BIAS-LIKE PATTERNS IN REASONING MODELS
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus was on implicit biases related to race, gender, age, and other non-religious social categories.
findings: The paper did not evaluate or report any findings related to religion or faith.
